articles.title: In Rajasthan, the girls who refuse to be spoken for
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II: Polity, Governance, Supreme Court Judgements, Bills & Govt Schemes
articles.keyPoints:
• Rajasthan ranks sixth among India’s States with the highest prevalence of child marriage, according to the latest National Family Health Survey (2023-24).
• Poverty, the lack of education, and entrenched customs such as atta-satta, reinforced by a skewed sex ratio, continue to fuel the practice, particularly in tribal and rural areas.
• Now, a growing number of girls, empowered by education and greater access to social media, are saying no, reports Ashok Kumar.
